## Find, fix, and prevent issues in your mobile app[Direct link to heading](https://docs.luciq.ai/\#find-fix-and-prevent-issues-in-your-mobile-app)

Learn how Luciq works, use it from the dashboard, your AI client, the CLI, or the API, and set up the SDK on any platform. Ask anything along the way.

![](https://docs.luciq.ai/~gitbook/image?url=https%3A%2F%2F2991836969-files.gitbook.io%2F%7E%2Ffiles%2Fv0%2Fb%2Fgitbook-x-prod.appspot.com%2Fo%2Fspaces%252FCha1KrkvNKPdcC0aGvuB%252Fuploads%252Fgit-blob-0a5cac717e57fb92596c7ac5907c0a8e4a554fd9%252FLuciq-Icon%2520%281%29.svg%3Falt%3Dmedia&width=768&dpr=3&quality=100&sign=8e6d1cf1325bbe0ecf502f30618e58e2&sv=3)

* * *

### Start here[Direct link to heading](https://docs.luciq.ai/\#start-here)

**How Luciq works**

From SDK signal to the Inbox to action, in five minutes.

**Product Guides**

Everything Luciq does, grouped by what you want to do.

**Inbox**

Issues and Opportunities in one place, ranked so you know what to work on next.

**Use Luciq from your AI client**

Ask Claude, Cursor, and other AI clients about your production data through the MCP server.

**Luciq CLI**

Scripts, CI pipelines, and symbol file uploads from your terminal.

**Luciq API**

Pull your Luciq data into your own scripts, dashboards, data pipelines, and CI checks.

### What do you want to do?[Direct link to heading](https://docs.luciq.ai/\#what-do-you-want-to-do)

**Watch what your user saw**

Replay the screens, interactions, and logs from a user session to see exactly what happened.

**Make crash reports readable**

Upload dSYMs, mapping files, source maps, and Dart symbols so stack traces show your code.

**Check if a release is healthy**

Compare your latest releases on the App Health Dashboard.

**Set up and tune alerts**

Get notified when stability or performance drops, then cut the noise.

**Integrations**

Use Luciq with the tools your team already uses, like Jira, Linear, Slack, PagerDuty, and Datadog.

**Set up the SDK with an AI agent**

Let your AI coding agent install and configure the Luciq SDK.
